2026-07-01.title: A Trendsetter
2026-07-01.verse: As a result you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaia.
2026-07-01.observation: Everyone likes the idea of being a trendsetter and starting something that becomes a fad. Everyone wants to be known for something. What a lot of people don’t realize is that a trendsetter doesn’t look like one at first. They look like an outcast. They are doing something no one else is doing and they stand out. Are you willing to stand out? The church was standing out as people who gave their lives for Christ and were living for Him. They were noticed for this bold stance. What about you? Are you willing to stand out?
2026-07-01.application: Never be ashamed of who you are in Christ.
2026-07-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being worthy.

2026-07-02.title: People are Some of God’s Greatest Gifts
2026-07-02.verse: For who is our hope or joy or crown to boast of before our Lord Jesus at his coming? Is it not of course you?
2026-07-02.observation: People are some of God’s greatest gifts. They can also (and will likely) be the source of some of our greatest hurts and wounds. However, there is almost nothing greater than watching someone take next steps with God. When you have a chance to see them step away from destructive sin and brokenness and toward freedom and wholeness… there is nothing like it. It is also a powerful thing when you start taking those steps and have people in your life cheering you on. Here’s the catch: these relationships are not cheap, they are not numerous, and they are not frequent. Good friendships take time and are more rare than we would like to admit. So, if you do not currently have close friendships, don’t rush out to go make friends too quickly. Friendship takes time. Be slow. Be purposeful. Guard your heart. Since the goal is to create friendships that last a lifetime, allow yourself to be patient. There are many people in the world. The Lord will lead you to the right ones.
2026-07-02.application: Pray and ask the Holy Spirit to lead you to the right friendships.
2026-07-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for sending Your Holy Spirit to guide us to the right kind of friends and to help us BE the right kind of friends.

2026-07-03.title: Goal: Overflowing Love
2026-07-03.verse: And may the Lord cause you to increase and abound in love for one another and for all, just as we do for you,
2026-07-03.observation: Paul’s goal for them is to love one another in such a way that it overflows. I know many people who struggle with this and I have discovered three main reasons so far: fear of being taken advantage of, selfishness, brokenness. Some do not let their love for one another inspire action because they know there are “takers” out there. They will take all you can give and then move on to someone else. The remedy for this is to love people enough to say no when it is enough. This is not easy because most do not receive the word “no” very easily. However, it can be a great lesson for you both. There are others who are simply selfish. They are the ‘takers.’ The remedy for this is to allow the Lord to soften their hearts and to be loved enough to receive instruction. The final kind are those who have been wounded in both situations. This one is hard because those who wounded you may not have had the most altruistic intentions. However, trust the Lord to bring healing, learn, and never stop working toward overflowing in love.
2026-07-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the greatest source of love.

2026-07-04.title: Loving God is Contagious
2026-07-04.verse: Now on the topic of brotherly love you have no need for anyone to write you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.
2026-07-04.observation: Some people are naturally generous and naturally kind to others. They just seem to look for ways to make a difference in the lives of people around them. Others do not have this trait naturally. They are not selfish or rude naturally. They simply do not think of others as part of their default character. What do we do? Get around God’s presence. Grow in your knowledge and understanding of God. As you slowly conform to the character of Christ, you will begin to take on His way of seeing the world. You will begin to see the world, not as an accident waiting to happen, but as an adventure to be experienced. People will not be victims and villains. They will be people worth being loved and honored. This doesn’t mean you are a pushover. It does mean you seek to be as much of a blessing as possible. God’s character is contagious if you stay close to Him.
2026-07-04.application: Have you found yourself slipping in your devotional life? Restart and commit to your spiritual disciplines.
2026-07-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us stay close to You always.

2026-07-05.title: Be Thankful
2026-07-05.verse: in everything give thanks. For this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
2026-07-05.observation: Thankfulness is one of the greatest and most underused superpowers we possess. It is amazing what we can do to our outlook on life, our self-esteem, our confidence, our courage, and our view of the past when we choose to be thankful. For most people, thankfulness is hard because we all have regrets, fears, anxieties, and concerns. We also feel like someone needs to attend to these fears and worries. We think that things will go wrong if we are not giving our attention to the “what if’s” of life. It is not denying reality to choose to be thankful. Thankfulness doesn’t deny there are bad things in our world. Thankfulness says that is not ALL there is in our world. Thankfulness is choosing what we focus our attention toward. It is realizing that God is working, even in difficult seasons.
2026-07-05.application: Choose to find three new things to be thankful for today.
2026-07-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the million little things You do every day that we never see. You are endlessly good to us.

2026-07-06.title: God’s Word Brings Joy
2026-07-06.verse: How blessed is the one who does not follow the advice of the wicked, or stand in the pathway with sinners, or sit in the assembly of scoffers. Instead he finds pleasure in obeying the Lord’s commands; he meditates on his commands day and night.
2026-07-06.observation: God’s Word brings joy. You end up resembling what you focus on. Think about it. If you are constantly watching or listening to content that is full of rage, conspiracies, or danger, you begin to see those things everywhere you turn. You end up finding what you are looking for when you go into your world. On the other hand, if we read God’s Word, focus on what it says, and live out what it says, we find ourselves with an increased sense of joy. We begin to see the world through the eyes of the Lord. We begin to see its brokenness but the hope He brings. We also no longer see the world as a place full of danger. We see the danger, but we also see His light.
2026-07-06.application: Do a personal audit. What do you focus on? Where do you need to focus less on the world and more on the Lord? What is one step you can take?
2026-07-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for bringing light into the darkness.

2026-07-07.title: Serve the Lord
2026-07-07.verse: Serve the Lord in fear. Repent in terror.
2026-07-07.observation: Today’s passage speaks of God as our King and One who is to be honored with reverent fear. For some reason there are many who think this is a bad thing. Perhaps it is the fault of us pastors and theologians. We have done so much work trying to help make God “relatable” that we have gone too far and made people think He is only a little better than us. Some see it as absurd to teach that we must have a holy fear of God. We are afraid of lions, so we give them respect, but we are not supposed to be the same toward God? God created the heavens and the earth. He can end it all in a second if He were to choose it. We have every reason to be afraid. However, the beautiful thing is that His character assures us He will not do so. He is good, and His mercy endures forever. Therefore, we have a holy fear because of what He could do, and we have a reverent love because of what He has done with this power. He has saved us.
2026-07-07.application: Think about the greatness of God. Realize how great He is and how good He is. We serve an amazing God.
2026-07-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us the way You do.

2026-07-08.title: The Lord is Our Protection
2026-07-08.verse: But you, Lord, are a shield that protects me; you are my glory and the one who restores me.
2026-07-08.observation: Many of us have not been in a situation like David. He was having to run for his life because Absalom, his son, was trying to kill him. Absalom overthrew the kingdom, assaulted David’s concubines, and would have killed his father if he could have. David was running for his life, he had been betrayed, and it did not seem as though anything could get worse. However, David remembered that true protection and strength do not come from anyone other than the Lord. He calls the Lord his shield. You need a shield when under attack. Therefore, David is acknowledging the reality of his trouble. He was being attacked in the worst way. However, that is not all that was happening. He also had the Lord on his side. When we experience difficulty and struggle, we must remember that is not all that is happening. We also have the Lord. He is helping us more than we realize and He is our true Source of protection and the One who holds our head up when everything is going wrong.
2026-07-08.application: Are you going through a hard time? Turn to the Lord. Remember that He is for you and His presence is our hope.
2026-07-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for standing with us when all else seems lost.

2026-07-09.title: Letting God Take the Night Shift
2026-07-09.verse: I will lie down and sleep peacefully, for you, Lord, make me safe and secure.
2026-07-09.observation: There was a time in my life when I had a hard time sleeping due to fears and worries. I was paralyzed by the possibilities of things I could not control. In today’s passage, the psalmist tells us that we do not have to live this way. We can rest because we know the Lord is ultimately in control. I will be honest and say that staying up and worrying has almost never helped. Sure, once or twice those late-night sessions provided an actionable idea. However, the overwhelming majority of the time, the only thing I accomplished was the loss of sleep. Sometimes, the most spiritual thing we can do is go to bed and trust the Lord. On particularly hard nights, I have started saying, “Okay Father. I am giving the control of the universe to You for the next few hours. I’ll be back in the morning.” That’s my way of remembering how absurd it is to think that I ever really had any control. It has always belonged to Him. It reminds me that He is in control and He is working in ways I do not even realize. I can trust in Him and go to sleep.
2026-07-09.application: Where do you need to trust the Lord? Do you need to borrow my prayer for a few nights and remind yourself in a fun way that the Lord is in control?
2026-07-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for truly being in control.

2026-07-10.title: Trusting in God is Like a Shield
2026-07-10.verse: But may all who take shelter in you be happy. May they continually shout for joy. Shelter them so that those who are loyal to you may rejoice. Certainly you reward the godly, Lord. Like a shield you protect them in your good favor.
2026-07-10.observation: In the New Testament, the Apostle Paul writes about what it is like to live with lives fully surrendered to our identity in Christ. He calls it the whole armor of God. He says that our trust, or faith, in God is like a shield that protects us from the fiery arrows of the enemy. When bad things come, our trust in God helps us to keep our perspective, guard against discouragement, and protects us from the lies of the enemy. This psalm says the same. Those who place their trust in God are surrounded with a shield of love. We know that God loves us. Therefore, whatever happens in this life is seen through the lens of being loved by our Heavenly Father. If He has led us to it, we can trust that He will lead us through it.
2026-07-10.application: Where do you need to hold up your shield of trust today?
2026-07-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for surrounding us with Your shield of love.

2026-07-11.title: The Lord Hears Your Prayers
2026-07-11.verse: The Lord has heard my appeal for mercy; the Lord has accepted my prayer.
2026-07-11.observation: This psalm comes from a place of pain and grief. The psalmist needs God’s restoration and longs for the Lord to be close. There is a beautiful moment at the end of the song that reminds us of the most beautiful truth about God. He is listening. He is working. Have you ever been in a conversation and the other person pulls out their phone while you are in mid-sentence? I have. It is awkward and embarrassing. The person most likely did not do it to be disrespectful. However, they became distracted and you were unable to hold their attention. Whether this is more of an indictment on you or them doesn’t matter. The bottom line is you realize you no longer have their full attention and the conversation slows to a stop. Have you ever wondered if God is “looking at His phone?” Do you have God’s full attention? Is the Lord moving? Does He care? The end of today’s song reminds us that God does hear us and He is moving in more ways than we can see. We do not have to worry or be afraid. God is not distracted. He hears our prayers. Help is on the way.
2026-07-11.application: Pray today like you have God’s undivided attention, because you do.
2026-07-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always hearing us when we call.

2026-07-12.title: God’s Justice is Worthy of Praise
2026-07-12.verse: I will thank the Lord for his justice; I will sing praises to the Lord Most High!
2026-07-12.observation: In times of difficulty, we can feel as though God is not near. I have sometimes felt as though the Lord is quick in His judgment when it comes to the things I do wrong, but is long-suffering in the way He deals with others. This is, of course, not true at all. The Bible says that the Lord is patient with us, because He doesn’t want any of us to be destroyed. Therefore, when God’s justice comes it is never too quick and never without a lot of patience. So, we can always see God’s justice as just, even when it happens to us. When we see God’s justice, we stand back in awe at the amount of patience He must have had before it came.
2026-07-12.application: Take a moment and think about all the times God could have judged you but didn’t. He is worthy of our praise.
2026-07-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for having so much mercy.

2026-07-13.title: Creation Shows the Goodness of God
2026-07-13.verse: For the music director, according to the gittith style; a psalm of David. O Lord, our Lord, how magnificent is your reputation throughout the earth! You reveal your majesty in the heavens above.
2026-07-13.observation: In Genesis, the Bible says that God created something out of nothing. Then, like a lump of clay, the Lord began molding it into something beautiful. When it was all done, He said it was very good. When we see creation now, we are always seeing an expression of His goodness. When we see a beautiful sunrise or sunset, that is God’s goodness on display through the beauty of creation. When we see a mountain view or a beautiful meadow of grass, this is God’s beauty on display. When we look up at the night sky and see all the stars, we can see His goodness on display. Think about this: Why would He do it that way? God could have made creation so much different and less glorious. It’s possible He made creation in such a way that we would always be surrounded with His goodness and be reminded every day that He is good and His goodness extends to us, too.
2026-07-13.application: Take a moment and look around at creation today. Then, remember the same God who made that loves you.
2026-07-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for surrounding us with reminders of Your goodness.

2026-07-14.title: Share Your Story
2026-07-14.verse: For the music director, according to the alumoth-labben style; a psalm of David. I will thank the Lord with all my heart! I will tell about all your amazing deeds. I will be happy and rejoice in you. I will sing praises to you, O Most High.
2026-07-14.observation: One of the saddest statements is when someone says they don’t have a testimony to share. In court, a testimony is what you witnessed. You are telling the truth from your perspective. That’s what you do when you share your story with others. You are sharing what the Lord has done in your life. People can sometimes become insecure about their story because they hear the stories of others and feel as though their story is not as interesting or compelling. However, this misses the point. The focus of the story is not you. The focus of the story is God’s goodness. When you tell of what the Lord has done and make it about Him, it is always an amazing story worth telling. So, share the story of God’s goodness in your life early and often.
2026-07-14.application: Find some way to share a short story of the Lord’s goodness in your life with someone today. Remember to make it all about Him.
2026-07-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so good that we could never run out of stories about Your faithfulness.

2026-07-16.title: The Lord Hears the Lowest Cries
2026-07-16.verse: Lord, you have heard the request of the oppressed; you make them feel secure because you listen to their prayer.
2026-07-16.observation: Sometimes, we can look at all the problems of the world and forget that God is not only big enough for all of them, He is also big enough to hear the smallest cry. I used to listen to my daughters pray at night about the simplest things and think, “Oh how cute.” I didn’t think the Lord would take these prayers seriously, because He had so many bigger things to worry about. However, as I have continued to study and watch the ways of God, I see I could not have been more wrong. The Lord is near to us all. He hears the prayers of world leaders and hears the prayers of a small child as they pray about wanting a good night’s sleep. He hears us when we pray loudly, and He hears us when all we can do is cry. He hears us all. Never feel as though you have to have the right volume, the right words, or the right emotions to be heard by God. You do not have to have a certain status or a title. All you have to do is remember that you are His child. That is enough.
2026-07-16.application: Pray with the confidence that you KNOW the Lord hears you.
2026-07-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always hearing our prayers.

2026-07-17.title: Trust the Lord in Uncertain Times
2026-07-17.verse: For the music director, by David. In the Lord I have taken shelter. How can you say to me, “Flee to a mountain like a bird.
2026-07-17.observation: In this song, David is talking about receiving advice from people who say he should panic, run, and watch out for the threats of his enemies. While David is not denying he has enemies and that they have evil plans, he acknowledges that God is greater than all of this. He says that he should not be afraid because God is on His Throne. Therefore, He is in control of all that happens. This does not mean that David is going around picking fights with every evil thing and hoping God will bail him out. David is saying he will not be afraid of any enemy that comes his way or any task that he has to complete because the Lord is with him. There is a difference between going out and looking for a fight and being ready if one finds you. When we truly trust the Lord, we do not have to fear the fights that come to us. We can be certain that they will come, and the Lord will be with us the whole way. Therefore, we prepare and do our best. Then, trust the Lord with the rest.
2026-07-17.application: Trust God with any battle you are facing today.
2026-07-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being strong enough to overshadow any enemy we face.

2026-07-18.title: God Fulfills His Promises
2026-07-18.verse: The Lord’s words are absolutely reliable. They are as untainted as silver purified in a furnace on the ground, where it is thoroughly refined.
2026-07-18.observation: My parents divorced when I was just a kid. Navigating divorce is complicated and painful for kids. Many times I would not see one of my parents for months at a time. Sometimes toward the end of a visit with one of my parents, they would make promises like, “The next time we are together, we’ll go to a park and play all day.” As an adult, I now realize that this was likely an offhand comment saying we were going to do something fun when we saw each other again. However, as a kid, I did not realize this was anything other than a specific promise. I would wait months to see them again and, if we did not go to the park, I would be disappointed. I had held onto that promise, and it would leave me feeling discouraged. I don’t blame my parents for this. They were human and did not understand the inner workings of a confused and insecure son. However, the LORD is not like that. He sees us. He knows our deepest thoughts and loves us completely. We can take His promises as true statements because they are completely true and completely trustworthy. So, when you see a promise in God’s Word, believe it.
2026-07-18.application: What promise from God’s Word do you need to hold onto today?
2026-07-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always fulfilling Your promises.

2026-07-19.title: Trusting God During Difficult Seasons
2026-07-19.verse: But I trust in your faithfulness. May I rejoice because of your deliverance. I will sing praises to the Lord when he vindicates me.
2026-07-19.observation: This psalmist spends the first several verses laying out all his problems. Then he ends by remembering that the LORD is trustworthy, even when difficult times come. This is helpful, because we can seem to be constantly putting God to the test. We don’t think of it this way, but we wonder if the LORD will come through this time like He did before. I think the question is more like, “Will He come through in the way I want Him to, unlike the way He did before?” The reality is that God does not move on our timetable, and His objectives are often more complex than our own. It reminds me of when my girls played sports. As a parent, I would watch the coach in the games. He obviously wanted them to win, but he also wanted them to win the right way. He wanted them to run the plays well, play as a team, and communicate well. There was more going on than just winning. Many times, there is more going on in the plan of God than our personal agenda. Therefore, we trust the Lord. He is working out more than we realize.
2026-07-19.application: How can you see your current difficulties through the eyes of God’s bigger plan?
2026-07-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for playing the long game.

2026-07-20.title: The Lord is With Us in Defeats
2026-07-20.verse: You want to humiliate the oppressed, even though the Lord is their shelter.
2026-07-20.observation: When I was a kid, I watched a lot of movies. I already had a vivid imagination and movies took me to different places, times, and universes. It was always an adventure. I also loved how almost all my favorite movies had a happy ending. No matter what the hero would face, they would somehow win in the end. The unfortunate thing is that life does not always go that way. Good does not always win at the moment. The hero does not always save the day. The team doesn’t always win the big game. People die. Marriages don’t last. Children go in directions we would not choose. What do we do? We take it to the LORD. He cares more than we do about the things that burden our hearts. We also take joy in knowing that God is good. He has won the ultimate battle and joy can be ours because good wins in the end. At the same time, that does not deny that we struggle in the moment. So take it to the LORD and let His comfort be with you today.
2026-07-20.application: What pain, hurt, and fear do you need to take to the LORD today?
2026-07-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every difficult season of life.

2026-07-21.title: The Journey Toward Wholeness
2026-07-21.verse: A psalm of David. Lord, who may be a guest in your home? Who may live on your holy hill? Whoever lives a blameless life, does what is right, and speaks honestly.
2026-07-21.observation: David is asking a rhetorical question. He is asking what it takes to be in the presence of God. He answers his own question by talking about the characteristics of someone who is living with integrity and joy. They are the ones who experience the goodness of the Lord’s presence. The important thing to remember is this does not mean God will not love you if you are not perfect. It is about a pursuit toward wholeness and holiness. It is about working toward a place where you walk in maturity before the Lord. The great principle to also remember is the Lord walks with you and helps you along the way. He does not want you to do any of this alone. We walk hand-in-hand with Him.
2026-07-21.application: What is the next step toward wholeness in your life? Where is the Lord asking you to walk in more integrity?
2026-07-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for challenging us toward holiness.

2026-07-22.title: The Way of Life
2026-07-22.verse: You lead me in the path of life. I experience absolute joy in your presence; you always give me sheer delight.
2026-07-22.observation: This psalm ends with the declaration that the way of life with God grants us joy in His presence and the pleasure of living with Him forever. These are two powerful promises for everyone who walks with the Lord through life. The first promise is that of joy. Joy is not an emotion. (Happiness is the emotion most often associated with joy.) For the Christian, joy is the settled confidence that God is in control. When we walk with the Lord, we can have joy because we realize the Lord is with us. We also have the promised pleasure of living with God forever. If Christianity is true, (and it is) we don’t actually die as much as change locations. So, the songwriter is saying following God is way better than all the troubles this world brings.
2026-07-22.application: How does the settled confidence of knowing the Lord is in control change your outlook on today?
2026-07-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us in more ways than we can imagine.

2026-07-23.title: Praying for Justice
2026-07-23.verse: Rise up, Lord! Confront him. Knock him down. Use your sword to rescue me from the wicked man. Lord, use your power to deliver me from these murderers, from the murderers of this world. They enjoy prosperity; you overwhelm them with the riches they desire. They have many children, and leave their wealth to their offspring.
2026-07-23.observation: Throughout his life, David experienced his fair share of difficulty. There were many times when he had every right to pray for God’s righteous justice to fall on his enemies. David had to run and hide from King Saul while being innocent. David was deposed as king by his evil son, Absalom. David had his own men go behind his back and do evil. However, we see a helpful pattern on how to handle the evil done toward us. We pray for God’s righteous justice to be done. This is important because we do not always know the full story. Most people we consider our enemies are not as bad as we think but are more broken than we realize. This does not excuse sinful behavior, but it does help begin to explain it. The uncomfortable reality is this is also a possible way to explain ourselves. We are not as bad as some people may think we are, and we are in the process of healing from brokenness that they do not see. Therefore, we pray for God’s justice because He knows more than we do. We also take the next step to protect or do what’s right. However, we leave the ultimate justice to Him. He is the only One worthy to judge us all.
2026-07-23.application: Who do you need to give to the Lord today?
2026-07-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your endless mercy and righteous judgment.

2026-07-24.title: God Helps Us
2026-07-24.verse: You give me your protective shield; your right hand supports me. Your willingness to help enables me to prevail.
2026-07-24.observation: There are certain things we simply do not understand until we live a little while. Recently, one of my girls was disappointed because she had a problem and I was unwilling to fix it. I told her I would help her work through it but I was not going to fix it. She needed to learn how to fix this herself with my guidance. In her frustration, she said that I never help her and don’t do anything for her. She said this while riding in my car, drinking something I bought her, wearing clothes I bought her, her stomach was full because of food I had provided, and was texting on a phone I was paying for. However, she was used to those blessings. Therefore, only something new would make her feel blessed or helped. Sometimes you have to live a little while to see the error of our ways. I remember thinking the same thing about my parents, so there were no hard feelings toward her. She did not realize how blessed she already was and I was trying to give her more help than she realized. I was working to not fix an issue, but teach a value that could perpetually fix issues. How many times does God do this to us? How many times do we complain to the Lord while enjoying His blessings all around us? I know I do. God is helping us more than we realize. He is for us more than we can guess. He is working even now. God’s help is all around us.
2026-07-24.application: Where do you need to say thank You to God for His help? Think of some things that you currently take for granted.
2026-07-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us in more ways than we will ever imagine.

2026-07-25.title: God’s Word Brings Life
2026-07-25.verse: The law of the Lord is perfect and preserves one’s life. The rules set down by the Lord are reliable and impart wisdom to the inexperienced. The Lord’s precepts are fair and make one joyful. The Lord’s commands are pure and give insight for life. The commands to fear the Lord are right and endure forever. The judgments given by the Lord are trustworthy and absolutely just.
2026-07-25.observation: Imagine someone told you they had discovered a secret that would unlock the treasures of life, help you find lasting joy, and lead you into a hope-filled tomorrow. That sounds so good that it would immediately be laughed off as impossible. What if they then said that you could test it and find out? Read a certain book and do what it says for 90 days then watch what happens. This is what God promises in His Word. He promises that following Him through obeying His Word leads to life, lasting joy, and hope for tomorrow. However, there are so many who would rather do almost anything other than read and follow God’s Word. Notice it is read and follow. Jesus said in Matthew 7 that only those who listen and follow His instruction find a firm foundation. What could happen in our lives if we truly saw God’s Word for what it was? It is the source of life because it points us to the Lord.
2026-07-25.application: Make a fresh commitment to read God’s Word every day, not to check it off your task list, but to see God more clearly.
2026-07-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us life by giving us a way to follow You.

2026-07-26.title: What Do You Boast About?
2026-07-26.verse: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we depend on the Lord our God. They will fall down, but we will stand firm.
2026-07-26.observation: Someone once said that you can tell a lot about someone by what they brag about. I once spoke with a great singer and worship leader. We were talking about a recent church service where he led the music. He bragged about how many stand ovations he received from hitting the high notes in the songs he led. It was easy to see where his heart was. He was not excited that people worshiped the Lord. He was excited that he was “worshiped.” On the other hand, I have talked with people who have experienced great success in their lives. While hearing their story, they continue to talk about how the Lord had opened doors and gave them His favor. You could tell from their story, they realized that the true architect of their success was the kindness of the Lord. There is nothing wrong with being proud of accomplishments, but it is important to remember where they come from. You can say thank you for a great compliment and give glory to the Lord at the same time. Be careful to always remember where all the good things of life come from. To God be the glory.
2026-07-26.application: What do you need to celebrate the Lord for today?
2026-07-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for the million little miracles You work every day that we do not even realize.

2026-07-27.title: Finding Joy in the Lord
2026-07-27.verse: For the music director, a psalm of David. O Lord, the king rejoices in the strength you give; he takes great delight in the deliverance you provide.
2026-07-27.observation: I have found that it is easier to complain than to celebrate. It is easier to find fault than to find good things. It is easier to focus on what has not been done than to focus on what has been completed. When we think of God, we tend to think about what we need Him to do or what He chose not to do in our lives. We remember the time we prayed for something, but God did not answer. We may also be focusing on the next prayer request we hope He answers our way. It is okay to ask God for things and to be fervent in our prayers. It is not okay to only focus on our needs. Joy comes when we look behind us and recognize all the things the Lord has already done in our lives. This song tells us about many things the king is celebrating about his relationship with God. When is the last time you stopped and celebrated all that the Lord has already done, prayers He has answered, and who He is? We are not denying we have needs. We are saying that God is bigger than them all and worthy of our celebration. This brings joy.
2026-07-27.application: Write down at least 20 things you can celebrate about God. Watch how it starts to change your perspective.
2026-07-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for bringing us joy every day.

2026-07-28.title: Victory is on the Way
2026-07-28.verse: For he did not despise or detest the suffering of the oppressed. He did not ignore him; when he cried out to him, he responded. You are the reason I offer praise in the great assembly; I will fulfill my promises before the Lord’s loyal followers.
2026-07-28.observation: This is a famous song because Jesus quotes from it while dying on the Cross. This psalm speaks about feeling rejected by God and suffering that sounds a lot like a crucifixion. What many people don’t realize is this is not a psalm of death and destruction. It is a psalm of hope. It is a messianic psalm. It was a famous psalm. When He said, “My God, My God. Why have You forsaken Me,” everyone in the crowd would have immediately known that He was declaring this psalm. These were the first words, and not a completed declaration. The psalm speaks about how horrible times have come and it appears as though the enemies are winning, however, God is in control and He will get the ultimate victory. Those who do not understand what Jesus was doing think that He was declaring that the sins of the world had come on Him and the Father had turned His back on Jesus. This cannot be true. The Triune Godhead cannot be separated. Rather, this is Jesus saying everything is going according to plan. Yes, it looks bad right now but don’t give up. This is all part of the plan. Victory is on the way.
2026-07-28.application: When reading this psalm, imagine Jesus on the Cross. He is not denying the horrible pain. He is just saying that victory is on the way. Take a moment and celebrate that the victory was our salvation.
2026-07-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for winning the victory for us all.

2026-07-29.title: The Lord is Our Shepherd
2026-07-29.verse: A psalm of David. The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
2026-07-29.observation: I have had the honor to go to many funerals. While they are all different, they almost all have one thing in common. They all have this song posted somewhere for the mourners to read. This is because Psalm 23 has brought comfort to countless billions over the years. David is speaking about how the Lord cares for His people in so many ways. He watches over us in more ways than we realize. He guards us from threats we will never even know existed. He goes before us, walks with us, and guards behind us. Therefore, we can say with confidence, “The Lord is our Shepherd. We have all we need.”
2026-07-29.application: Take a moment and think about how the Lord guides us with His unseen hand. Depending on the season you are in, this is either a comfort or creates questions. However, if you could trust Him in the past, you can trust Him now.
2026-07-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for guiding us through life.

2026-07-31.title: Closeness With God Costs You Something
2026-07-31.verse: Who is allowed to ascend the mountain of the Lord? Who may go up to his holy dwelling place? The one whose deeds are blameless and whose motives are pure, who does not lie, or make promises with no intention of keeping them. Such godly people are rewarded by the Lord, and vindicated by the God who delivers them. Such purity characterizes the people who seek his favor, Jacob’s descendants, who pray to him. (Selah)
2026-07-31.observation: I knew someone who once said they couldn’t understand why they struggled to make friends. Because I knew their story, I had an idea as to why this was happening. This person often asked other people to change who they were, but never wanted to do anything different for others. They wanted others to do all the work in friendship. The hard reality is friendship has a cost. You have to be willing to not always make it about yourself. You have to sometimes do what other people want to do, and realize there are some things that are simply not about you. Why should serving God be any different? When it comes to being a Christian, some people treat it as though they are doing God a favor by being saved. That could not be further from the truth. We come to God out of His mercy. Then, He says He wants to walk with us in fellowship. This means that, as the psalmist said, “climbing the mountain of the LORD” will take effort on our part. Think about it. Do you ever expect God to do things for you, but bristle when God’s Word commands something of you?
2026-07-31.application: How can you find joy in realizing all God’s promises are true, but serving God must be done His way?
2026-07-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us in the right direction.
